title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 7 November 2026
description: The banking regulator hits Macquarie Group with a fresh $100 million capital overlay, Mount Morgan celebrates the completion of a long-awaited water pipeline, and the Gold Coast gears up for tonight's Pan Pacific Masters Games opening ceremony. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
